steps.title: 🔑 Connect your app with an API key
steps.description:
API keys let your app fetch config values from the portal. Each environment gets its own key.

**Example flow:**
1. Generate a key for `production`
2. Add it to your app: `SDK.init({ clientId: 'cid_xxx' })`
3. Fetch flags: `const darkMode = config.get('feature.dark_mode')`

steps.title: Open API Keys
steps.description: Click here to generate and manage your SDK keys. Each key is scoped to one environment.

steps.title: ✅ Ready to integrate
steps.description:
Copy the key and use it in your app's SDK initialization.

> **Security tip:** Never expose production keys in client-side code. Use the key server-side or in your mobile app's secure storage.
